positions.name: ThistlewickDiagnosticScopeAndSequence
positions.frame: how long should the Thistlewick diagnostic run, and in what order should it work through the people it interviews?
positions.why: Both statements read the same diagnostic plan as revised from the 1 October call. src-1 gives the duration (two weeks down to eight working days) and ties it to the four warehouse shift leads. src-2 holds the sequencing, warehouse team before management, as unchanged. The pair is consistent: one thing changes and one holds, and the frame covers both without settling either.
